subject: Quick walkthrough — Redwood demo & compliance check
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina@scaleharbor.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Interest after the "Serving LLMs at Scale" session

Hi Markus,

I attended your session "Serving LLMs at Scale" at DevOps Summit last week — great talk, thanks. I’m with ScaleHarbor (platform team) and we’re evaluating inference platforms for a pilot. Can we do a quick 20-minute walkthrough of Redwood next week to see fit and surface any compliance questions up-front?

Priority items for us: latency profiles on short chat workloads, data isolation options for PII, and an overview of rollout/rollback controls. I’m in PST — Wed/Thu morning PST works best.

Thanks,
Nina Patel
Lead Platform Engineer, ScaleHarbor
nina@scaleharbor.io

P.S. I registered at the event — ref: CONF-DEVOPS-0427
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Patel <nina@scaleharbor.io>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest after the "Serving LLMs at Scale" session

Hi Nina — thanks for joining the session and for reaching out. I’m Markus on the SDR team — happy to set up a short walkthrough focused on the items you listed.

I have the following 20-minute slots next week (all PST):
- Wed Apr 13, 9:00–9:20 AM PST
- Wed Apr 13, 11:30–11:50 AM PST
- Thu Apr 14, 8:30–8:50 AM PST

Or feel free to pick a time that works via my quick booking link: https://calendly.com/redwood/20min

I’ve looped in Rachel (AE) who can join and cover compliance questions. If there are other folks from your side to include, let me know and I’ll add them to the invite.

Best,
Markus Klein
SDR, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0127

Thanks Markus — appreciate the options. Thu Apr 14 at 8:30 AM PST is ideal for us. Can you please include our infra lead Carlos Ruiz (carlos@scaleharbor.io) on the invite — he’ll ask the deeper security/ingest questions.

A couple quick asks so we can prep:
- Can you send a short agenda (2–3 bullets) so Carlos and I can prioritize?
- Do you have a brief PDF or doc we can skim on data isolation and private deployment?

Cheers,
Nina
